Plays a pooled sound. `pitch` lets one asset cover a whole musical range — rising pitch on consecutive taps is what makes clicking feel good.

Write the Luau implementation.<|eot_id|><|start_header_id|>assistant<|end_header_id|>

```luau
function AudioEngine.play(name: string, pitch: number?, volume: number?)
	if settings.sfxVolume <= 0 then
		return
	end
	local bank = pool[name]
	if not bank then
		return
	end

	-- find a free voice; if all are busy, steal the oldest
	local chosen: Sound? = nil
	for _, s in bank do
		if not s.IsPlaying then
			chosen = s
			break
		end
	end
	chosen = chosen or bank[1]
	if not chosen then
		return
	end

	chosen.PlaybackSpeed = pitch or 1
	chosen.Volume = volume or 1
	chosen:Play()
end

function UI.panel(parent: Instance, title: string, size: UDim2): (Frame, Frame, () -> ())
	local scrim = Instance.new("TextButton")
	scrim.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	scrim.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Colour.void
	scrim.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
	scrim.Text = ""
	scrim.AutoButtonColor = false
	scrim.Visible = false
	scrim.ZIndex = 10
	scrim.Parent = parent

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Size = size
	frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Colour.surface
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.ZIndex = 11
	frame.Parent = scrim
	UI.corner(frame, Theme.Radius.lg)
	UI.stroke(frame, Theme.Colour.line, 2)

	local header = UI.label({
		parent = frame,
		text = title,
		size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 38),
		position = UDim2.new(0, Theme.Space.md, 0, Theme.Space.sm),
		font = Theme.Font.display,
		align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	})
	header.ZIndex = 12

	local function close()
		UI.tween(frame, Theme.Motion.fast, { Size = UDim2.new(size.X.Scale * 0.94, size.X.Offset, size.Y.Scale * 0.94, size.Y.Offset) })
		task.delay(UI.a11y.reducedMotion and 0 or 0.12, function()
			scrim.Visible = false
			frame.Size = size
		end)
	end

	local closeBtn = UI.button({
		parent = frame,
		text = "✕",
		size = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 42),
		position = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0, 8),
		colour = Theme.Colour.danger,
		onClick = close,
	})
	closeBtn.ZIndex = 12

	scrim.MouseButton1Click:Connect(close)

	local content = Instance.new("Frame")
	content.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -54)
	content.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 54)
	content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	content.ZIndex = 11
	content.Parent = frame

	return scrim, content, close
end

function AchievementService:bump(player: Player, stat: string, amount: number?)
	local data = self.Data.get(player)
	if not data then
		return
	end

	data.stats = data.stats or {}
	local current = (data.stats[stat] or 0) + (amount or 1)
	data.stats[stat] = current

	local list = watchers[stat]
	if not list then
		return
	end

	data.achievements = data.achievements or {}
	for _, a in list do
		if current >= a.goal and not data.achievements[a.id] then
			data.achievements[a.id] = os.time()
			data.crystals += a.crystals
			Net.fireClient("AchievementUnlocked", player, {
				id = a.id,
				name = a.name,
				desc = a.desc,
				crystals = a.crystals,
			})
			-- Cosmetics can be gated on the same stats; re-check on every unlock.
			local cos = Registry.tryGet("CosmeticService")
			if cos then
				cos:checkUnlocks(player)
			end
		end
	end
end

	local data = self.Data.get(player)
	local def = Content.getCosmetic(id)

function EconomyService.applyOfflineEarnings(player: Player)
	local data = DataManager.get(player)
	if not data or data.lastLogin == 0 then return 0 end

	local elapsed = math.max(0, os.time() - data.lastLogin)
	local capped = math.min(elapsed, GameConfig.MaxOfflineHours * 3600)
	if capped < 60 then return 0 end

	local earned = EconomyService.getAutoIncome(player) * capped * GameConfig.OfflineEfficiency
	if earned <= 0 then return 0 end

	EconomyService.addGoo(player, earned)
	Net.fireClient("OfflineEarnings", player, earned, capped)
	local ach = Registry.tryGet("AchievementService")
	if ach then ach:setStat(player, "maxOfflineClaimed", capped) end
	return earned
end

Drops the least valuable items when over the cap. Equipped items are never pruned — losing something you're actively using would be indefensible.

```luau
function InventoryService:prune(player: Player, kind: string)
	local data = self.Data.get(player)
	if not data then
		return
	end
	local items = container(data, kind)
	if #items <= MAX_ITEMS then
		return
	end

	local equipped = {}
	for _, uid in (data.equipped or {}) do
		equipped[uid] = true
	end

	local scorer = self.valueOf and self.valueOf or function()
		return 0
	end

	table.sort(items, function(a, b)
		local ae, be = equipped[a.uid] and 1 or 0, equipped[b.uid] and 1 or 0
		if ae ~= be then
			return ae > be
		end
		return scorer(a) > scorer(b)
	end)

	for i = #items, MAX_ITEMS + 1, -1 do
		items[i] = nil
	end
end

Luck shifts weight from Common toward the rarer tiers. We divide the common weight rather than multiplying rare weights, which keeps the published odds easy to state honestly in the UI.

Write the Luau implementation.<|eot_id|><|start_header_id|>assistant<|end_header_id|>

```luau
local function rollPet(luck: number)
	local pool = {}
	local total = 0
	for _, pet in GameConfig.Pets do
		local r = GameConfig.Rarities[pet.rarity]
		local w = r.weight
		if pet.rarity == "Common" then w /= luck end
		total += w
		table.insert(pool, { pet = pet, w = w })
	end
	local roll = rng:NextNumber() * total
	local acc = 0
	for _, entry in pool do
		acc += entry.w
		if roll <= acc then return entry.pet end
	end
	return pool[1].pet
end

```luau
local function coerce(def: Content.Setting, value: any): any?
	if def.kind == "toggle" then
		if typeof(value) ~= "boolean" then
			return nil
		end
		return value
	elseif def.kind == "slider" then
		if typeof(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value then
			return nil
		end
		return math.clamp(math.floor(value), def.min or 0, def.max or 100)
	elseif def.kind == "choice" then
		if typeof(value) ~= "string" or not def.choices then
			return nil
		end
		for _, c in def.choices do
			if c == value then
				return value
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
	return nil
end

		if child:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			local ok, mod = pcall(require, child)
			if ok and typeof(mod) == "table" then
				ServiceRegistry.register(child.Name, mod)

	local newPath = ""

		while index <= #path do

			if character == "/" then
				character = "\\"
			end

			newPath ..= character
			index += 1
		end

function EvaluateInstancePath(object)
		-- "Recursive" eval
		local ObjectPointer = object

		-- Input itself doesn't exist?
		if not ObjectPointer then
			return
		end

		local Path = ""

		while ObjectPointer do
			local ObjectName = ObjectPointer.Name
			local ObjectClassName = ObjectPointer.ClassName
			local ObjectParent = ObjectPointer.Parent

			if ObjectParent == game and IsService(ObjectPointer) then
				-- ^^ Then we'll use GetService directly, since it's actually a service under the DataModel

				Path = ":GetService(" .. SerializeString(ObjectClassName) .. ")" .. Path
			elseif not LuaKeywords[ObjectName] and string_match(ObjectName, "^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$") then
				-- ^^ Like the `string` DataType, this means means we can index the name directly in Lua
				-- without an explicit string
				Path = "." .. ObjectName .. Path
			else
				Path = "[" .. SerializeString(ObjectName) .. "]" .. Path
			end

			if ObjectParent == game then
				Path = "game" .. Path
				return Path
			elseif ObjectParent == workspace then
				Path = "workspace" .. Path
				return Path
			end

			-- Advance ObjectPointer, whether it exists or not (JUMPBACK)
			ObjectPointer = ObjectParent
		end

		-- Fall back to no ret.. Only objects parented under game/workspace will be serialized
		return
	end
